title: Bulk Receptionist Job Collector input
description: Collect high-volume US home-service receptionist, CSR, dispatcher, and scheduling postings with full descriptions and cross-run history.

mode.title: Collection mode
mode.description: Recent is intended for frequent scheduled runs. Backfill searches a wider historical window.

states.title: US states
states.description: Leave empty to search all 50 states plus Washington, DC.

roleFamilies.title: Role families
roleFamilies.description: Leave empty to collect every supported receptionist-adjacent role family.

tradeBundles.title: Home-service trade bundles
tradeBundles.description: Leave the defaults to cover the complete home-service taxonomy.

freshnessDays.title: Maximum posting age
freshnessDays.description: Discard postings whose published date is older than this many days; postings without a date are retained.

partitionIndex.title: Partition index
partitionIndex.description: Zero-based partition used to split national coverage across frequent runs.

partitionCount.title: Number of partitions
partitionCount.description: Use 4 with four daily schedules. Each state is covered once per day.

maxSerpRequests.title: Maximum SERP pages per run
maxSerpRequests.description: Hard discovery-cost ceiling for this run.

resultsPerQueryPages.title: SERP pages per query
resultsPerQueryPages.description: Number of Google result pages collected for each generated query.

maxJobFetches.title: Maximum job pages fetched
maxJobFetches.description: Hard limit on unique candidate job URLs processed during this run.

maxPostings.title: Maximum output postings
maxPostings.description: Maximum accepted posting records written to the default dataset.

fetchConcurrency.title: Page-fetch concurrency
fetchConcurrency.description: Maximum number of job-detail page requests running at the same time.

revisitAfterDays.title: Days before refetching a known URL
revisitAfterDays.description: Known descriptions are served from cache until this interval passes.

strictHomeService.title: Require home-service evidence
strictHomeService.description: Only retain postings whose content contains a home-service trade or field-service signal.

includeSnippetOnly.title: Keep blocked jobs using their search snippet
includeSnippetOnly.description: Retain relevant discoveries even when the detail page is blocked and only the Google snippet is available.

includeExpired.title: Include explicitly expired jobs
includeExpired.description: When disabled, discard structured postings whose valid-through date has passed.

trackHistory.title: Track posting history
trackHistory.description: Persist posting fingerprints across runs to identify new, changed, repeated, and likely reposted vacancies.

historyStoreName.title: Persistent history store
historyStoreName.description: Named Apify key-value store used for cached descriptions and cross-run posting history.

seedUrls.title: Optional seed job URLs
seedUrls.description: Optional known job-detail URLs to process in addition to search discoveries.
